title: Unified unveiling choreography for Adaptive Routing — timing, release notes, and cross-channel playbooks
creator: Priya Shah
description: Coordinated announcement plan for the Adaptive Routing feature targeting developers and platform customers. Goal: deliver a single, synchronized launch across blog, email, social, and a technical webinar while ensuring release notes are complete, support runbooks are ready, and legal/infosec signoff is obtained before any public distribution. This ticket owns the cross-team orchestration, channel-level timing, embargo handling, and rollback/playbook steps. Success metrics include developer signups from blog, webinar attendance >250, and <1% support tickets related to API compatibility within first 72h.

notes: Trade-offs: Prefer coordinated single-day launch to maximize PR impact, at cost of higher cross-team coordination risk. Fallback is staged release (docs first, public blog + webinar later).
Rollback policy: If API errors >0.5% of requests for 15m, toggle routing to previous model variant and pause new traffic. Engineering playbook attached in dependencies.
Monitoring: Dashboard will track error rate, latency P95, usage growth, support ticket volume, and churn signals for first 72h.
Embargo: Strict embargo until 2026-03-15 10:00 UTC. Violation policy: immediate internal incident and PR hold. Only green-lit artifacts to be shared externally.
